_meta.ps_backfill_2026_07_15: PS visual page-read: QB 50->52 (injury context), RB 42->44 (2024 Pendergrass volume), OL 38->40 (93 incoming career starts). DL 47 held (PS 'best Baylor DL since Aranda arrived' noted); LB 38 L held (PS optimism is health-conditional - the same caveat).

rationale_bullets: The volume king graduated (Robertson 70.3/590; 3,681-31, both top-5 national) and the replacement is the cycle's biggest QB swing: Lagway - #1 QB of the 2024 class, 16 Florida starts, 66.7/401 off his worst year (2nd-best SEC rating 2024 -> second-worst 2025).
The scheme-fit case is attributed and unusually specific: Spavital's offense 'reminds me of my high school offense' (5,500/75 in it at Willis); 6-5 240 adds a run element.
Depth is 7 career snaps (Bennett); the line in front is rebuilt.
50 = average: elite ceiling, off-year floor, no depth.

PS-backfill 2026-07-15: Lagway's 2025 came on an August injury ('not 100%... a 100% healthy Lagway was a Heisman contender into '25 and he is healthy again' - PS). Injury attribution strengthens the rebound case. 50 -> 52.
13th-pctile as-played room loses its volume back (Washington 70.3/163, fumbles -> Auburn).
The 2026 plan IS an injury return: Pendergrass missed all of 2025 (foot) and is the named lead (P6/Athlon agree); Knighten (68.3 on 111 att as a true FR) is the proven-est piece.
42 = below average: no returning 500-yd producer, lead back off a lost season, pass-tempo scheme.
PS-backfill 2026-07-15: Pendergrass was Baylor's #2 back in 2024 with 671 @ 5.5 (6-142 vs OkSt) - real volume before the foot injury; 3 of 4 backs return + Morris. 42 -> 44.
Total target wipeout from a 75th-pctile room: all four WRs (Cameron 72.4/512 1st-tm All-B12, Hawkins, Wilson, Prentice) + TE Trigg (72.5/319) gone.

The replacement haul's verified tape is moderate: Freeman (66.0/266 OkSt), Gilmore (64.7/240 UK), Livingston TE (76.2 on just 60 routes, followed Lagway); the framed headliner Miller spent 2025 at RB (53.4/130) - his WR tape is 2024.
Returners Porter (58.4/78) + redshirt-override Brown IV (50 career routes) are projection, not production.
44 = fringe-below-average: bodies and pedigree without a proven 300-route FBS target; proxy's 87 is a documented expiration artifact.
4 of 5 starters gone from a 56th-pctile line - incl. the All-B12 anchor (Aigbedion 80.0/684) and two SEC-poached starters (Price 71.0/842 -> UK; Thompkins -> LSU).

The rebuild is G5-transfer-grade on real volume: Walker (Memphis C, 60.9/881 - manual-append row), Moore (UAB LT, 65.0/650), Rhett (61.0/669), Hale (48.1/695); Kibble (Texas LG) is a 38-snap projection; Sieracki (63.0/948) is the lone returning starter.
P6's frame is attributed: 'the starting five were all three-star recruits or transfers.'
38 = bottom-third-plus: more verified (if modest) tape than a bare rebuild, no above-average returner but Sieracki.
PS-backfill 2026-07-15: the incoming transfer class carries 93 career starts (Memphis/Toledo/S.Ala/UAB) vs my grade-quality-only read; experience mass matters for OL cohesion. 38 -> 40.

The 2025 floor was historic: 24th-pctile as-played, 13 sacks = fewest by a B12 defense in a decade - and the program's response is documented ('most money we've spent on defense' - Aranda; Klanderman's havoc scheme).

Seven adds carry tape: Ponder (80.9/392 S.Miss - best incoming grade), Mack (74.8/206), K.Washington (70.8/382), Wheeler (70.7/420 Indiana - appeal PENDING), Whyce (65.7/412), Wimberly, Davis (KState JACK); plus the #1 overall JUCO prospect Hardy (no tape).
Returning: Tezino (63.3/510, bold) + late-season starter Kyler Jordan; the losses (Lanz 73.5, Winston, Fobbs-White) thin what worked.
47 = fringe-average: heavy verified reinforcement onto a bad floor; Wheeler's pending status and G5-weighted tape cap it.
The leader left (Thomas 69.3/793 -> Ole Miss) from a 38th-pctile room.

The above-average case rides one injury return: Barnes (yr-4 override; former C-USA POY at FIU; 62.0 on 67 snaps in 2025). Around him: Reed (58.7/606, demoted to Athlon's 2nd string), Burns (47.0/133, 'rising four-star' starting as a So), adds graded 46-54.
LB caution rule applied - and here it bites: pedigree is the only strong signal and it is health-dependent. 38, L.
The roster's best-shaped unit: two All-B12-honored starters return (Redding 75.2/468 - the team's best returning grade, the KSU pick-six; Thornton 64.5/522) plus Bush (66.9/331) and yr-2 T.Turner.

The pedigree add is attributed: D.Turner (Northwestern All-B10, back from ACL) - Klanderman's 'difference-maker'; verified depth arrives with tape (Cobbs 69.7/415 KState, D.Jordan 66.2/232 OU, McKelvey 65.8/319).
Losses are real but second-order (Bobby 802 expired, Coleman -> Florida, Williford -> Tulsa).
52 = average-plus: honored returners + tape-verified depth, capped by CB2 battle and a first-year scheme.
96th-pctile SPEC (88.2) in 2025, and the driver returns: P Williams, a Ray Guy finalist at 46.9 ypp.
The kicker half resets late: Hawkins left in the late portal window (-> Ohio State); Armstrong has ZERO career FG attempts (kickoffs only, highly-rated HS leg per Athlon).
52 = average-plus: elite punting retained, placekicking a pure unknown, returns open.
